about.text: Queso panela is a fresh cheese common in Mexico made from pasteurized cow's milk. It is also known as queso canasta or queso de la canasta. It is derived from the Greek word for basket cheese. The cheese also has similarities to the Indian cheese paneer.

how.label: drain in baskets
how.text: Large, gently handled curds are salted in the vat and left to drain in woven baskets without pressing, so the cheese keeps a high moisture content and takes the basket pattern on its surface. It is sold straight away, unripened.

steps.note: Into large cubes, 1 in in the traditional make.

steps.name: salt
steps.note: Dry salt or concentrated brine is added to the curd.

steps.name: mould
steps.note: The wet curd drains overnight in basket-weave moulds.
